The method checks two conditions: 1) if main thread queries are allowed (`mAllowMainThreadQueries`), it returns without any action; 2) if the current thread is the main thread (`isMainThread()`), it throws an `IllegalStateException`. The exception is thrown to prevent potential UI locks due to long-running database operations on the main thread. The method is annotated with `@hide` and `@RestrictTo`, indicating it is intended for internal library use rather than public API.
